text.content: Independent web evidence reviewed: ERP literature describes ERP as integrating multiple enterprise functions including finance/accounting with other organizational functions; sources also acknowledge that ERP has varying interpretations. This supports the persisted Scope-before-Label rule as a major criterion, while preserving its stated limitation that it is a working evidence-based rule rather than a universal ontology. No existing Knowledge Asset required correction or supersession in this cycle.
